course.title: Thermodynamics of Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Determine which of the following properties of a thermodynamic system are extensive properties and which are intensive: (i) Mass density, (ii) Molar density, (iii) Potential energy of a system in a gravitational field, (iv) Molar concentration on NaCl in salt solution, (v) Heat absorbed by the gas in a cylinder when it is compressed.
